words.definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually in a large building.
words.example: She lives in a small apartment.

words.definition: large objects like tables, chairs, and beds used in a home.
words.example: We bought new furniture for the living room.

words.definition: to pay money regularly to use a home that belongs to someone else.
words.example: They rent a flat near the station.

words.definition: a person who owns a property and rents it to other people.
words.example: Our landlord fixed the broken window.

words.definition: a person who pays to live in a property owned by someone else.
words.example: The new tenant moved in last week.

words.definition: a loan used to buy a house, paid back over many years.
words.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their house.

words.definition: a small platform outside an upstairs window or on a high floor.
words.example: We had breakfast on the balcony.

words.definition: a building where you keep a car.
words.example: He parks his car in the garage.

words.definition: an area of land next to a house where you grow plants.
words.example: She grows flowers in her garden.

words.definition: a room or floor of a building that is below ground level.
words.example: We store old boxes in the basement.

words.definition: the inside surface of the top of a room.
words.example: The lamp hangs from the ceiling.

words.definition: the covering on top of a building.
words.example: Snow covered the roof.

words.definition: a piece of cloth that covers a window.
words.example: Please close the curtains.

words.definition: a machine used at home, like a fridge or a washing machine.
words.example: A microwave is a useful kitchen appliance.

words.definition: having furniture already inside.
words.example: We rented a fully furnished flat.

words.definition: having a lot of space; large.
words.example: The kitchen is bright and spacious.

words.definition: warm and comfortable.
words.example: Their living room feels very cozy.

words.definition: to start living in a new home.
words.example: We will move in next Friday.

words.definition: a person who lives next to or near you.
words.example: Our neighbor is very friendly.

words.definition: a bill for services like water, gas, or electricity.
words.example: We pay the utility bills every month.

text: Two months ago, Sam moved into a new apartment in the city center. He rents it from a friendly landlord, and Sam is now his tenant. The apartment is small but very cozy, and the landlord says it is more spacious than it looks. It has a nice balcony where Sam can sit outside in the evening, but no garden or garage, because it's in a big building. There is no basement either, but the ceiling is high, which makes the rooms feel bigger. The apartment came furnished, so Sam didn't need to buy a lot of furniture — just a few small things. It already had modern appliances in the kitchen, like a fridge and a washing machine. Sam bought new curtains for the bedroom because the old ones didn't match his style. Every month, Sam has to pay rent and also the utility bills for electricity and water. He hopes that one day he can buy his own home with a mortgage, instead of renting. Since he moved in, Sam has met some of his neighbors, and they are all very kind. He often talks to them near the roof terrace of the building.
